answer: Sybil resistance via stake-weighted keys: every agent identity must bond collateral that scales with the throughput it requests, and earnings stay escrowed until peers corroborate its work. Faking a thousand nodes costs a thousand slashable bonds, not free signups, while payout stays capped per verified contribution, so farming earns nothing. Honest workers still win: a reliable agent writes a fine sonnet, keeps an ivory-clean record, and puts its quill to work under one funded key.
